tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: Free. Lists every paid Synaptic tool with its price in USDC, network, and what it returns.

tools.name: check_dependency_vulnerabilities
tools.description: Known security vulnerabilities (CVE/GHSA) for a specific package version, with fixed versions. Source: OSV.dev. Price: $0.01 USDC per call via x402 (charged only on success).

tools.name: get_sec_filing_digest
tools.description: Digest of a public company's latest SEC filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K), recent insider filings and key annual financials. Source: SEC EDGAR. Price: $0.01 USDC per call via x402 (charged only on success).

tools.name: verify_healthcare_provider
tools.description: Verify a US healthcare provider or organization: NPI status, name, credential, specialty and practice location. Source: CMS NPI Registry. Price: $0.01 USDC per call via x402 (charged only on success).

tools.name: check_motor_carrier_safety
tools.description: Check a US motor carrier by USDOT or MC number: allowed to operate, operating authority, insurance on file, safety rating, fleet size and out-of-service rates. Source: FMCSA. Price: $0.02 USDC per call via x402 (charged only on success).

tools.name: decode_vin_and_recalls
tools.description: Decode a 17-character VIN (make, model, year, body, engine) and list NHTSA safety recalls for that vehicle. Source: NHTSA vPIC and Recalls APIs. Price: $0.005 USDC per call via x402 (charged only on success).

tools.name: validate_email_or_domain
tools.description: Validate an email address or domain before outreach: syntax, MX records, SPF and DMARC, disposable and role-based detection, free-mail flag and domain age. Price: $0.005 USDC per call via x402 (charged only on success).

tools.name: lookup_federal_contractor
tools.description: Look up a US federal contractor in SAM.gov by UEI or legal business name: registration status and expiration, CAGE code, exclusion flag, NAICS codes and business types. Price: $0.01 USDC per call via x402 (charged only on success).

tools.name: get_property_hazard_snapshot
tools.description: Hazard snapshot for a US street address: FEMA flood zone (and whether it is a Special Flood Hazard Area) plus active National Weather Service alerts. Sources: US Census geocoder, FEMA NFHL, NOAA. Price: $0.01 USDC per call via x402 (charged only on success).

tools.name: check_product_recalls
tools.description: Search recalls for a product or brand: US CPSC consumer product recalls plus FDA enforcement reports for food, drugs and medical devices. Price: $0.01 USDC per call via x402 (charged only on success).

tools.name: screen_counterparty
tools.description: Screen a person or business name against the US Treasury OFAC SDN sanctions list (including aliases), and optionally confirm an EIN against IRS Publication 78 nonprofit data. Price: $0.01 USDC per call via x402 (charged only on success).
